What the measurements mean

The design records 35 published, 39 derived and 48 estimated scalar parameters. Canopy contours, installed component heights, blade profiles and small electronic details include estimates. This is a visual reference model, not a manufacturing drawing or a physical scan.

The browser asset is a separately optimized export of the editable Blender model. Component positions and selected dimensional anchors are retained; local mesh reductions are checked against documented sampled deviation limits. Lighting and transparent materials can look different in a browser. The exploded view uses illustrative spacing; the optional battery is shown with the power lead unplugged.
